items.content: System of government where power rests with the people. Citizens participate through voting and representation. Foundation of many modern nations.
Universal, inalienable rights belonging to all people. Include freedom, dignity, and equality. Protected by international law and constitutions.
Development that meets present needs without compromising future generations. Includes environmental, social, and economic dimensions.
Rights related to digital technology. Include privacy, free expression online, and protection from cyber threats. Evolving with technology.
Philosophy of collaborative, transparent software development. Code is freely available. Promotes innovation, transparency, and community.
Right of nations and communities to control their digital infrastructure. Prevents corporate and foreign lock-in. Essential for independence.
